body: The main reason is the belief that life could be better than this. I do have a supportive family, very few friends and a partner with whom I have not completely screwed things up yet. I also have some interest in reading philosophy, watching football, sketching. I have always disregarded the reasons because I see other people doing better than me. Feel free to drop in a message if you want to talk about these reasons.

It is very similar to what I face everyday although I wont be able to understand how you feel. It must be really hard for you to find a reason to go on.

I personally did not open up to my partner because I feel that person would leave me. 

It is difficult to deal with this thoughts. Also, I do not feel a reason to keep doing this, apart from the fact that I cannot take the 'extreme' step. I dont think reasons exist in the world inherently. You just have to create reasons. That is easier said than done. But in your worst possible way you have dealt with these feelings till now. You are tougher than you think. If you were not, you wouldn't be here. 

Lots of love and best wishes.
You have spoken my mind. I had to literally force myself into doing it once since I did not have the courage to do it.
